summary.confidence: Low to moderate: 3 runs per arm per case; each case run in isolation (one test per Playwright invocation), whereas the 2026-10-07 failures were recorded in one full 17-case suite run.
summary.observation: Seven of eight attributed cases passed in isolation on current source (not-reproduced; 3/3 in both arms). One case, the time-limit lifecycle, fails 0/3 in isolation on current source and passes 3/3 on aed271f; narrowing found it passing 3/3 at 336099e and failing 0/3 at b1e2801 and e0f78d7. Narrowing rows carry the classify label of their own arm pair; for narrowing only the reference-arm pass count is used. sameCaseSource.identical is a line-range heuristic of the case body and is false for several cases whose spec text changed in Phase 7.
